stories.headline: SK Hynix Begins Mass Production of 192GB SOCAMM2 Memory Module for Nvidia's Vera Rubin

key_facts.fact: SK hynix announced it has begun mass production of the 192GB SOCAMM2 module, the industry's first optimized for Nvidia's Vera Rubin AI accelerator platform.
key_facts.excerpt: SK hynix Inc. announced today that it has begun mass production of the 192GB SOCAMM2, a next-generation memory module standard based on the 1cnm process (sixth-generation of the 10-nanometer technology) LPDDR5X low-power DRAM.

key_facts.fact: SOCAMM2 delivers more than double the bandwidth and over 75% improved energy efficiency compared to conventional RDIMM server memory modules.
key_facts.excerpt: SOCAMM2 offers more than twice the bandwidth of RDIMM, the conventional server memory module, and improves energy efficiency by more than 75%.

key_facts.fact: SOCAMM2 adapts LPDDR mobile memory for server environments using a compression-type connector in modular form, allowing easy attachment, detachment, and replacement unlike conventional soldered LPDDR.
key_facts.excerpt: SOCAMM2 (Small Outline Compression Attached Memory Module2) is a module standard that adapts low-power memory used in mobile devices such as smartphones for server environments. It uses a compression connector structure to improve signal integrity and make module replacement easier.

key_facts.fact: The module is built on SK hynix's most advanced 10nm-class sixth-generation DRAM (1c) process, which offers about 11% faster speeds and 9%+ better power efficiency versus the prior 1b generation.
key_facts.excerpt: Industry officials said DDR5 built on the 1c process is known to offer about 11 percent faster speeds and more than 9 percent better power efficiency compared with 1b-based DDR5.

key_facts.fact: SK hynix shares hit an intraday record high of 1,175,000 won ($796) on the news before closing at 1,166,000 won, up 3.37%, driving KOSPI higher.
key_facts.excerpt: The stock hit an intraday record high of 1,175,000 won ($796) before closing at 1,166,000 won, up 3.37 percent.

key_facts.fact: SK hynix said it stabilized its mass production system early to meet demand from global cloud service providers as the AI market shifts from training to inference.
key_facts.excerpt: To meet the demands of its global Cloud Service Provider (CSP) customers, SK hynix has not only been providing a supply portfolio, but also stabilized its mass production system early on.

stories.headline: Intel Foundry Boosts Equipment Orders 50%+ YoY as 14A Process May Draw Nvidia, Apple, AMD

key_facts.fact: Intel has been actively ramping up chipmaking equipment orders since the start of 2026, with volumes rising by more than 50% compared with last year.
key_facts.excerpt: Sources say Intel has been actively ramping up chipmaking equipment orders since the start of 2026, with volumes rising by more than 50% compared with last year.

key_facts.fact: UBS Group says Intel's 14A process technology has received positive feedback from Nvidia, Apple, Google, and AMD, who are likely to adopt the technology for chip manufacturing.
key_facts.excerpt: According to information disclosed in a UBS Group report, Intel's 14A process technology has received positive feedback from several chip companies. These semiconductor companies include NVIDIA, Apple, Alphabet, and Advanced Micro Devices.

key_facts.fact: Intel is expected to officially sign foundry cooperation agreements with 14A clients this fall once PDK 1.0 becomes available; an earlier PDK 0.5 version has already been released.
key_facts.excerpt: Companies such as Google, Apple, AMD, and NVIDIA could consider committing this fall once PDK 1.0 becomes available to customers. Intel has already released an earlier version, PDK 0.5.

key_facts.fact: Intel's EMIB advanced packaging technology, which competes with TSMC's 2.5D solutions, is another lever to attract foundry customers beyond the 14A node.
key_facts.excerpt: EMIB, its advanced packaging technology that competes with TSMC's 2.5D solutions, could serve as another lever to help turn around its foundry business.

key_facts.fact: Equipment orders span multiple Intel sites including Oregon and Arizona in the US, as well as Israel and Ireland, with supply chain partners KINIK and E&R Engineering seeing rising volumes.
key_facts.excerpt: KINIK Company's diamond discs have been adopted by Intel since the second half of last year, with shipments covering multiple sites, including Oregon and Arizona in the U.S., as well as Israel and Ireland.

stories.headline: NextDC Raises AU$2.2B as AI Demand Drives 60% Jump in Contracted Data Center Capacity

key_facts.fact: NextDC is raising AU$2.2 billion total: AU$1.5 billion in a fully underwritten equity entitlement offer at AU$12.70 per share plus AU$700 million expansion of its hybrid securities programme.
key_facts.excerpt: NEXTDC has halted trading to launch a A$2.2 billion capital plan anchored by a fully underwritten A$1.5 billion equity entitlement offer.

key_facts.fact: Contracted utilisation jumped by 250MW (60%) in a single quarter to 667MW as of March 31, 2026, compared with end-December 2025.
key_facts.excerpt: Pro forma contracted utilisation, the total power capacity formally signed up by customers, jumped by roughly 60% to 667 megawatts (MW) as of March 31, compared with end-December 2025.

key_facts.fact: Forward order book grew 83% to 544MW over the same period, driven by hyperscale cloud providers and AI infrastructure customers.
key_facts.excerpt: Its forward order book grew 83% over the same period to 544MW, driven by hyperscale cloud providers and AI infrastructure customers.

key_facts.fact: Canada's La Caisse de dépôt et placement du Québec committed an additional AU$700 million, bringing total backing to AU$1.7 billion.
key_facts.excerpt: Canada's La Caisse has committed an additional A$700 million, following its initial A$1 billion pledge earlier this month.

key_facts.fact: FY26 capex raised by AU$300 million to AU$2.7B–AU$3.0B range, reflecting accelerated build-out of the 350MW S4 facility in Horsley Park, Western Sydney.
key_facts.excerpt: NextDC's FY26 capital expenditure (capex) guidance has been increased by $300 million... with FY26 capex in the range of $2.7 billion to $3 billion.

key_facts.fact: NextDC's combined forward order book and existing billing utilisation is expected to generate estimated EBITDA in excess of AU$1 billion, over 4x mid-point FY26 EBITDA guidance.
key_facts.excerpt: The pro forma forward order book combined with its existing billing utilisation is expected to generate estimated EBITDA in excess of $1 billion... over four times the mid-point of FY26 EBITDA guidance.

stories.headline: Fermi CEO Departs as Trump-Branded Texas Data Center Megaproject Faces Mounting Setbacks

key_facts.fact: Co-founder and CEO Toby Neugebauer departed from Fermi, replaced by Marius Haas as Chairman of the Board; Neugebauer remains a board member.
key_facts.excerpt: Fermi co-founder Toby Neugebauer has departed from his role as Chief Executive Officer, but he remains a member of the Board.

key_facts.fact: Fermi announced 'Fermi 2.0' strategic evolution with new Dallas headquarters, expanded board from five to seven members, and interim leadership under COO Jacobo Ortiz.
key_facts.excerpt: Fermi 2.0 represents a comprehensive progression of the Company's strategic direction, governance structure, and operating platform.

key_facts.fact: The Project Matador campus in the Texas Panhandle, named the 'President Donald Trump Advanced Energy and Intelligence Campus,' is the world's largest planned data center project.
key_facts.excerpt: The world's largest data center project — backed by Trump allies and bearing his name — is stalled by delays and logistical hurdles that could stop it before it even starts.

key_facts.fact: Fermi's shares have lost 75% over the past six months and plunged further in aftermarket trading following the CEO's departure.
key_facts.excerpt: That sent the company's shares, which already shed 75% in the last six months, plummeting in aftermarket trading.

key_facts.fact: Neugebauer admitted he was naive about the complexity of building the project, particularly the cooling systems essential for AI chips.
key_facts.excerpt: Neugebauer told Axios he may have been naive about how complex these projects are to put together, particularly the cooling systems that are essential to cool the AI chips.

key_facts.fact: Texas Tech University System remains committed to the partnership but is in discussions to extend certain lease agreement milestones as the project enters its next phase.
key_facts.excerpt: TTUS remains firmly committed to our partnership with Fermi America... we are actively engaged in good-faith discussions to extend certain milestones in the lease agreement.

stories.headline: Apple Delays Mac Studio to October and Touchscreen MacBook Pro to 2027 Amid DRAM Shortage

key_facts.fact: Apple's new Mac Studio, originally expected mid-2026, is now delayed to approximately October 2026 due to global memory shortages.
key_facts.excerpt: These supply problems aren't only slowing down the MacBook Pro; they're also delaying updates to other products like the next Mac Studio, which might now launch in October 2026.

key_facts.fact: The redesigned MacBook Pro with OLED display, touchscreen, and M6 Pro/M6 Max chips has been pushed from late 2026 to early 2027.
key_facts.excerpt: The redesigned MacBook Pro models—initially expected to launch in mid-2026—may now be delayed until early 2027.

key_facts.fact: The delays are caused by global DRAM and SSD shortages driven by AI data center demand consuming available chip supply, with manufacturers meeting only ~60% of demand through 2027.
key_facts.excerpt: The holdup comes from global memory shortages, making it tough to get enough RAM and SSDs for production, according to Bloomberg's Mark Gurman.

key_facts.fact: Bloomberg's Mark Gurman reported on April 19 that memory shortages are pushing back several Apple product launches, with the information embedded in his Power On newsletter.
key_facts.excerpt: According to a report by Mark Gurman of Bloomberg, the redesigned MacBook Pro models—initially expected to launch in mid-2026—may now be delayed until early 2027.

key_facts.fact: Apple is reportedly paying double the market price for Samsung DRAM chips; high-configuration Mac Studio models with 512GB RAM are already delisted or chronically out of stock.
key_facts.excerpt: Der Konzern soll bereits das Doppelte des Marktpreises für Samsung-DRAM-Chips zahlen... Hochkonfigurierte Mac-Studio-Modelle mit M3 Ultra-Chip und 512 GB RAM sind bereits ausgelistet oder dauerhaft ausverkauft.

stories.headline: Seattle Mayor Explores Data Center Moratorium After 54,000 Letters Oppose AI Power Demand

key_facts.fact: Seattle Mayor Katie Wilson announced she is exploring a moratorium on siting new data centers within city limits after massive public backlash.
key_facts.excerpt: Mayor Katie Wilson stated that no permits have been authorized yet and that the city is considering a moratorium to protect ratepayers and environmental interests.

key_facts.fact: Four companies — including Prologis, Equinix, and Sabey — approached Seattle City Light about building five large-scale data centers with a combined peak demand of 369 megawatts, roughly one-third of Seattle's average daily power consumption.
key_facts.excerpt: Four companies had approached Seattle City Light about building five large-scale data centres with a combined peak demand of 369 megawatts, roughly equal to a third of Seattle's average daily power consumption.

key_facts.fact: More than 54,000 letters were sent to Seattle City Council and the Mayor's Office opposing data center construction, an extraordinary volume of civic response.
key_facts.excerpt: More than 54,000 letters had been sent to Seattle City Council and the Mayor's Office by Saturday.

key_facts.fact: Seattle City Light is rewriting contract terms for large-load customers, likely requiring data centers to find their own power generation and pay for infrastructure upgrades to protect residential ratepayers.
key_facts.excerpt: The utility is rewriting its contract terms for large-load customers, with the new policy likely requiring data centres to find their own power generation outside the city's supply and to pay for any infrastructure upgrades they need.

key_facts.fact: Seattle already faces a strained hydropower supply due to four consecutive years of drought, and its utility must nearly double maximum electricity generation by 2033.
key_facts.excerpt: Seattle's utility already faces the task of nearly doubling its maximum electricity generation by 2033, driven by building electrification, electric vehicles and population growth.

key_facts.fact: The move follows Maine's passage of the first statewide data center moratorium and over $156 billion in data center projects blocked or stalled by local opposition in 2025.
key_facts.excerpt: Seattle's mayor is exploring a moratorium on new data centres as Maine passes landmark legislation, as communities count the cost of the AI infrastructure boom.

stories.headline: Huawei Launches Pura X Max Foldable and Pura 90 Series With In-House Kirin 9030 Chip

key_facts.fact: Huawei launched the Pura X Max, a passport-style foldable with a 5.4-inch cover display and a 7.7-inch internal display, in China starting at approximately $1,613.
key_facts.excerpt: Huawei has launched its passport-style foldable in China... 5.4-inch cover display and a 7.7-inch internal display... starting at ~$1,613.

key_facts.fact: The Pura X Max runs on Huawei's in-house Kirin 9030 chip (3nm process, 9-core architecture), with a Kirin 9030 Pro variant for the premium edition, despite ongoing US sanctions on Huawei's semiconductor supply chain.
key_facts.excerpt: Both devices are powered by Huawei's latest Kirin 9030S chipset... advanced artificial intelligence.

key_facts.fact: Huawei simultaneously launched the Pura 90 Pro and Pura 90 Pro Max smartphones, with the Pro Max featuring a first-of-its-kind 200MP RYYB telephoto sensor on a 1/1.28-inch sensor.
key_facts.excerpt: The most groundbreaking addition is the 200MP telephoto camera equipped with a large 1/1.28-inch sensor—marking the first time Huawei has deployed a sensor of this immense resolution specifically for telephoto zoom.

key_facts.fact: The Pura X Max features a 16:10 aspect ratio inner screen, HarmonyOS 6.1 with AI assistant 'Xiaoyi,' 100W wired and 80W wireless charging, and supports a stylus pen.
key_facts.excerpt: The Pura X Max launched in China today.

key_facts.fact: The predecessor Pura X sold over 1.5 million units, and over 100 robot teams and 12,000 preorders were placed before the Pura X Max launch event.
key_facts.excerpt: Huawei has officially expanded its premium smartphone portfolio with the introduction of the Huawei Pura 90 Pro and Pura 90 Pro Max.
